name: LANDMRK
recent: Landmarks Berhad 近期推进一项拟议收购，由其间接全资子公司 Tiara Gateway Pte Ltd 以 RM4.48 million 收购 Mendol Investments Pte Ltd 的 5.10% 股权，代价通过发行 Landmarks 新股支付，并已向 Bursa Securities 提交上市申请。公司同时出现多项董事、委员会成员、公司秘书及主要高管变动，并因触及 Rule 8.03A 持续发布月度公告。最新季度（2026-06-30）营收环比增长 11.8%，但同比减少 23.6%，仍录得净亏损。
notable: 拟议由 Tiara Gateway Pte Ltd 以 RM4.48 million 收购 Mendol Investments Pte Ltd 的 5.10% 股权，代价通过发行 Landmarks 新股支付。
已就拟议收购向 Bursa Securities 提交代价股份的上市及报价申请。
2026 年 10 月出现多项董事、审计委员会、薪酬委员会、公司秘书及主要高管变动。
risks: 拟议收购以发行新股支付，涉及股本扩大。
公司因 Paragraph/Rule 8.03A 持续发布月度公告。
最新季度仍录得净亏损，营收同比减少 23.6%。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM4.31 million，环比增长 11.8%，同比减少 23.6%；净亏损为 RM4.612 million，净亏损率为 107.0%，较上一季度的 149.2% 净亏损率有所收窄。

recent_en: Landmarks Berhad is proceeding with a proposed acquisition by its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Tiara Gateway Pte Ltd of a 5.10% equity interest in Mendol Investments Pte Ltd for RM4.48 million, to be satisfied via the issuance of new Landmarks shares, with the listing application submitted to Bursa Securities. The company also saw several changes in directors, committee members, company secretaries and a principal officer, and continues to issue monthly announcements under Rule 8.03A. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 11.8% QoQ but fell 23.6% YoY, and the company remained in net loss.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition by Tiara Gateway Pte Ltd of a 5.10% equity interest in Mendol Investments Pte Ltd for RM4.48 million, to be satisfied via the issuance of new Landmarks shares.
Listing and quotation application for the consideration shares under the proposed acquisition has been submitted to Bursa Securities.
Several changes in directors, audit committee, remuneration committee, company secretaries and principal officer occurred in October 2026.
risks_en: The proposed acquisition is to be satisfied via the issuance of new shares, involving share capital dilution.
The company continues to issue monthly announcements under Paragraph/Rule 8.03A.
The latest quarter remained in net loss, with revenue down 23.6% YoY.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM4.31 million, up 11.8% QoQ but down 23.6% YoY; net loss was RM4.612 million with a net margin of -107.0%, compared with -149.2% in the previous quarter.
